description: This Java source file defines an abstract helper class TabHelper for building and managing tabs in an Android application, with behavior depending on the Android version. It includes factory methods, abstract methods for adding tabs and handling state, and methods for creating new tabs with version-specific implementations.

classes.name: TabHelper
classes.description: An abstract class providing a framework for tab management tailored to different Android versions, facilitating tab creation, addition, and state management in Android applications.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method that returns a platform-specific subclass of TabHelper based on the device's Android version.

methods.name: newTab
methods.description: Creates a new tab with a specified tag, returning a version-appropriate CompatTab implementation.

methods.name: addTab
methods.description: Abstract method to add a tab to the helper; implementation depends on subclass.

methods.name: onSaveInstanceState
methods.description: Abstract method to save the current state into a Bundle.

methods.name: onRestoreInstanceState
methods.description: Abstract method to restore the state from a Bundle.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Abstract method for setup procedures, to be implemented in subclasses.
